facts.fact: 乐园里那栋房子到处是门，但没有一扇通向外面。
facts.anchor: THE theme park house was full of doors, but none of them led out.

facts.fact: 西德妮试过的四扇门里，三扇通回别的走廊，第四扇通向死路。
facts.anchor: Of the four she’d tried, three had led back onto other halls, while the fourth had led nowhere.

facts.fact: 第五扇门推开，外面是清晨的冷空气和游乐设施后头一段摇晃的台阶。
facts.anchor: Nearly crumpled in relief when it swung open onto cold morning air and a set of rickety steps at the back of the ride.

facts.fact: 远远看去，维克多只是个瘦削的轮廓，身边围着一圈穿黑色装备的探员。
facts.anchor: This far away, he was little more than an outline, a lean shadow surrounded by agents in black gear.

facts.fact: 她全力冲向维克多，像八年前那样——那时她害怕，他是安全的。
facts.anchor: Sydney took off at a dead sprint, running toward him the way she had eight years ago, when she was scared, and he was safe, but the pull was even stronger now, with a force like gravity between them.

facts.fact: 她把他带回来的那天结下的那条线，又绷紧了。
facts.anchor: That cord she’d made, the day she brought him back, drawn taut again.

facts.fact: 一只戴着手套的手钳住她的嘴，掐断了她的叫喊。
facts.anchor: a gloved hand vised around her mouth, cutting off her scream

facts.fact: 伊莱把她按在自己身上，说「抓到你了」。
facts.anchor: “Caught you,” growled Eli, crushing her back against him.
